home.title: Fitness training starts with a plan that fits you.
home.subtitle: Enter your profile, goal, and priority body parts. The system selects candidate exercises from the database, then uses an LLM or rule-based fallback to generate an actionable plan.
home.privacy: No login or password required. The browser stores only an anonymous user_id; avoid entering sensitive personal data.
